ITEM 1 | Brown grain mixture with dark flecks, slightly clumped and loose, scattered grains of varying shape, spread across the left-center of the plate covering roughly 20% of the plate, mounded about 1.5 cm high, dry-looking with no visible sauce, sitting beside the green beans and greens | 120
ITEM 2 | Bright green, slender whole beans with a slightly glossy, firm, smooth surface, arranged in a loose bundle across the upper-left of the plate covering roughly 8% of the plate, about 0.5 cm high, some ends trimmed, no visible browning | 60
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad leaves in shades of green and burgundy-red, with crisp, ruffled, slightly moist leaves, spread across the right side covering roughly 25% of the plate, about 2 cm high at the mound, with a few darker wilted edges and a small orange segment of fruit or vegetable piece near the top center | 70
ITEM 4 | Small orange segment with glossy, smooth, slightly translucent skin-like surface, about 2.5 cm across and 1 cm high, sitting among the salad leaves at the top right of the greens | 15
ITEM 5 | Small pale-orange piece with soft, moist look, about 1 cm across, tucked beneath the salad leaves at the bottom edge of the greens | 5
